description.value: Straight Up Cycles is a full-service bike shop in Victoria operating since 2000, grown from a repair-focused origin into a shop offering new and used road, cyclocross, and mountain bikes alongside bespoke custom builds using brands such as Bassi Frames. Every bike sold leaves the shop fitted to its new owner, and experienced mechanics handle everything from flat fixes to complete strip-and-rebuild overhauls. A rotating consignment section adds used inventory for cyclists looking for a pre-owned ride.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: staple (4 spaces) at 32m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and confirms this is a legitimate full-service Victoria bike shop established in 2000. Staff help with urgent mechanicals is supported by the services page ('our experienced mechanics are happy to work on any bike, by any manufacturer. Whether a quick wheel true, or a full overhaul monster-project') and the flat-fix walk-in language ('tell us your issue and we'll do our best to help at a fair price'). E-bike service is confirmed as available but discretionary per the services page disclaimer ('E-BIKE SERVICE SUBJECT TO OUR DISCRETION'), with a surcharge listed on all tune packages.
